title: Firecrawl MCP v3: 3,000+ tools, higher limits, and agents that delegate
summary: Firecrawl MCP v3 gives your AI agent 3,000+ tools with automatic provider waterfalls, up to 60x higher rate limits, 4x more usage, and parallel subtasks.
body_markdown:
Ask an agent to find a contact's work email, and there's a decent chance it comes back with "not found." Usually the answer exists. It was sitting with the next provider, the one the agent never asked.


Today we're releasing Firecrawl MCP v3. One connection gives your agent 3,000+ tools, and when a provider comes up empty, v3 tries the next one for you. Rate limits are up to 60x higher, you get 4x more usage, and your agent can hand work off to subtasks that run in parallel.


It's live today in every harness:[alexandria.firecrawl.dev/go/mcp](https://alexandria.firecrawl.dev/go/mcp) .


## Why it's better, in plain English


**For you:** you connect once and get the whole catalog, so there's no wiring up providers one at a time. Your runs are far less likely to stall on a rate limit. And every plan includes free MCP usage that refreshes daily.


**For your agents:** they hit fewer dead ends, because one call keeps looking until it finds the record. They can run hundreds of lookups without hitting a wall, and they can delegate work and keep moving while it finishes.


## One connection, 3,000+ tools


The MCP connects your agent to the full Firecrawl Alexandria catalog: company data, people data, research, and government records.[Search](https://www.firecrawl.dev/search) ,[Scrape](https://www.firecrawl.dev/scrape) , and[Parse](https://www.firecrawl.dev/parse) sit right next to them.


Your agent describes what it needs, and the MCP finds the right tool. Provider discovery is about 8x faster than in v2, so your agent spends its time on the task instead of the lookup.


## When the first source comes up empty


A waterfall keeps going after the first "not found." The people enrichment waterfall checks one source, then the next, until it finds the record. Your agent makes one call and gets one answer.


## More room before you hit a limit


Search through the MCP is about 2x faster. Rate limits are up to 60x higher, and you get 4x more usage through the MCP.


That headroom matters once your agent stops making one call at a time. A research agent checking 200 companies in an afternoon shouldn't stall at company 40.


## Your agent can delegate now


Your agent can spawn subtasks that run in the background while it keeps working.


Ask for background on ten prospects, and the agent can split that into ten subtasks, run them in parallel, and pick up the results as they land.


## Works wherever your agent does


MCP v3 works in Claude, ChatGPT, and any harness that speaks MCP. Connect it once, and the same 3,000+ tools follow your agent wherever it runs.


## Try it


Connect it at[alexandria.firecrawl.dev/go/mcp](https://alexandria.firecrawl.dev/go/mcp) , point your agent at something hard, and tell us how it goes on X at[@firecrawl](https://x.com/firecrawl) .
